pick.headline: Gorbachev announces withdrawal of the Soviet brigade from Cuba
pick.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of September 12, 1991, carried TASS on the Gorbachev-Baker news conference, where Gorbachev said talks with Havana on withdrawing the Soviet training brigade of 11,000 troops would begin soon, and Baker welcomed the decision.

alternates.headline: Bush's 'new world order' address to Congress
alternates.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of September 13, 1990, carried IZVESTIYA's report of Bush's address to Congress, quoting his "new partnership of nations" and a new world where right replaces "the law of the jungle," and his account of the Gulf blockade.
